sources.quote: Messier 60 or M60, also known as NGC 4649, is an elliptical galaxy approximately 57 million light-years away in the equatorial constellation of Virgo.

introduction.text: Its picture is the Sloan Digital Sky Survey's, with the Milky Way's foreground stars removed, standing as a flat picture that faces the Sun.
